title: Sum of a list
description: The exercise template contains a base that reads numbers from the user and adds them to a list. Reading is stopped once the user enters the number -1.

paragraphs: The exercise template contains a base that reads numbers from the user and adds them to a list. Reading is stopped once the user enters the number -1.
Modify the program so that after reading the numbers it calculates and prints the sum of the numbers in the list.
